name: Apple customer reviews RSS feed
description: The only free route to App Store review text: a paginated JSON feed of up to 500 recent reviews per app, with rating, title, body and app version. Undocumented, unstable, and aggressively rate-limited - it returned a flat 403 for the whole of one build in September 2026 - but there is no supported alternative, and the four obvious substitutes are all closed.

license.name: unclear - undocumented endpoint
license.redistribution: quote individual reviews with attribution to the app; do not redistribute the corpus

access.size_hint: 50 reviews per page, 10 pages, so 500 per app maximum
access.rate_limit: about 5 requests/second is tolerated. Roughly 50/second earned a flat 403 across the whole endpoint for well over an hour.
access.etiquette: write one file per app and skip what already exists, so a blocked run resumes instead of restarting

probes.description: Page 1 for Apple Store app id 375380948
probes.note: A 403 here is the documented behaviour, not a dead endpoint: this feed answered normally earlier on 2026-09-06 and returned 403 after a few dozen requests from the same IP during that day's testing. The block lasted well over an hour when it was first measured. Wait, do not retry.

recipes.title: Resumable review harvest
recipes.code:
import json, os, time, urllib.request
def fetch(app_id, page):
    url = ('https://itunes.apple.com/us/rss/customerreviews/'
           'page=%d/id=%s/sortby=mostrecent/json' % (page, app_id))
    r = urllib.request.urlopen(url)
    if r.status != 200:            # a 403 body is HTML and will look like your bug
        raise SystemExit('blocked at %s page %d' % (app_id, page))
    return json.load(r)

for app_id in ['375380948']:
    out = 'reviews_%s.json' % app_id
    if os.path.exists(out):        # resume after a block
        continue
    rows = []
    for page in range(1, 11):      # 10 pages x 50 = the 500 ceiling
        feed = fetch(app_id, page).get('feed', {})
        entries = feed.get('entry', [])
        if page == 1:
            entries = entries[1:]  # entry[0] is the app, not a review
        if not entries:
            break
        rows += entries
        time.sleep(0.2)
    json.dump(rows, open(out, 'w'))

gotchas.trap: Exceeding the rate limit returns 403 with an HTML body, so a json.load raises a decode error and it looks like a parsing bug in your own code.
gotchas.fix: Check response.status before parsing, and stop the run on the first 403 rather than hammering.

gotchas.trap: On page 1, entry[0] is the app itself, not a review. An empty feed omits the entry key entirely rather than returning [].
gotchas.fix: Slice off the first entry on page 1 and use .get('entry', []).

gotchas.trap: Four obvious substitutes are closed: the older /rss/customerreviews/id= path (same block), amp-api.apps.apple.com (401, wants a bearer token that is in neither the page HTML nor the bundles), the product page's serialized-server-data (only 8 Apple-chosen reviews), and ?see-all=reviews (renders client-side).
gotchas.fix: Budget for the RSS feed at 5 req/s, or buy a commercial ASO feed.
